payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean and internally consistent. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel, 28×28 RGB) is correctly identified with split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) matching the official MedMNIST distribution exactly; no subsampling. Archive MD5 and SHA-256 are present and the MD5 cross-checks against verified_archive_md5. The Zenodo data reference points to the standard pathmnist.npz artifact. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is properly recorded and will be relevant when interpreting OOD AUROC aggregates as the arithmetic mean across corruption severities. Run manifest pins seed 72, deterministic_torch=true, and all package versions (torch 2.14.0+cu126, lightning 2.6.5, medmnist 3.0.2, numpy 2.4.6, scikit-learn 1.9.0, pydantic 2.13.5, jsonargparse 4.52.0). No deterministic findings were raised. One minor observation: llm_model_digest is null for the ollama-hosted qwen3.8 model, meaning the exact model revision is not pinned; this is acceptable if the LLM is used only for auxiliary commentary and not for core training/evaluation logic, but it should be noted for full reproducibility. No blocking issues; proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for ollama qwen3.8; the exact model revision is not pinned, which slightly weakens full reproducibility of any LLM-assisted analysis steps (non-blocking).
